title: console inbox and home: the Activity feed lists platform events (JWKS keys, data migrations, owner backfills, every login) to business users — the feed reads the app's business objects only
body:
Filing gate ① (a product defect, measured on `main`), filed on the maintainer's word (chat, 2026-10-15, session `session_019YFzJp4o8Ck4NsT1toC4UP`, seat account os-bill): the seat ran a functional audit of the HotCRM console on objectui `main` `720f6d4` (report, private to the maintainer: https://claude.ai/artifact/XPrn5eZMsQaKUgasMJEMmR, finding F5, figure 13), and the maintainer answered 「同意开卡，使用 pm-dispatch 创建卡片」. Quota note: the audit's cards exceed the filing gate's three-per-fire quota on that word, which approved the report's card list as a set.

Parent: #12444. Blocks nothing; nothing blocks it.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:ui` lane's next dispatch (seat post #9800), one dev round in `@object-ui/app-shell` (`hooks/sharedUserFeeds.ts`, `layout/ActivityFeed.tsx`, the console home's feed), size S–M.

**Dedupe** (MCP `search_issues`, scope objectstack-ai/objectui, all states, read 2026-10-15T14:14Z): "activity feed shows system events JWKS key data migration sys objects inbox notifications filter business objects only" → 0. None is this card.

## What happens

The bell's Activity feed tab and the console home's Activity feed card show, to the HotCRM admin a minute after a fresh seed: 「Dev Admin Created JWKS Key "QdKJl6LTc2jHmOx3…"」 (JWKS Key), 「Created Data Migration "adr-0104-value-shapes"」 and 「"adr-0104-file-references"」 (Data Migration), 「Owner: ∅ → Dev Admin · Knowledge Article」 twice, then the user's own 「Updated User "Dev Admin"」 on every login (the `last_login_at` write). A sales user reading this feed sees platform plumbing named after ADRs and key ids; the business events (a lead created, an opportunity's stage changed) are below them or off the page of twenty.

## Readings (objectui `origin/main` `720f6d4`, read 2026-10-15T14:15Z)

1. `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/sharedUserFeeds.ts` line 10 (the feed table) and line 685 (`ACTIVITY_OBJECT = 'sys_activity'`): the recent-activity feed is `find('sys_activity', top 20, sort -timestamp)` with no filter on `object_name`; lines 622–645 map rows to items by `type`.
2. `packages/app-shell/src/layout/ActivityFeed.tsx` lines 55–70 and 122: the only filter is `isKindEnabled(notificationPreferences, a.type)` (the user's per-kind switches); nothing filters by object.
3. `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useHomeInbox.ts` feeds the console home's card from the same reading.
4. API reading (HotCRM backend, admin): `GET /api/v1/data/sys_activity?top=20&sort=-timestamp` returns rows with `object_name` `sys_user` (every login writes one), `sys_jwks_key`, `sys_data_migration`, `knowledge_article`, then `crm_lead`; the `sys_*` rows carry `organization_id: null`.

## What to build

1. The user-facing feeds (the bell's Activity tab, the console home card) read business activity only: rows whose `object_name` is an object of an installed app the user can open, which excludes the platform's `sys_*` objects and system-only writes (an `object_name` the app roster does not list). The exclusion is derived from the object roster the shell already holds, not a hand-written list of names.
2. The user's own `sys_user` login write (`last_login_at`) is never feed material, whatever the roster says.
3. The platform events stay where an admin looks for them: the Setup / audit surfaces read the same `sys_activity` unfiltered, as today. The query's `top` applies after the filter (a filtered read, not a client-side drop that empties the page).

## Acceptance

- `sharedUserFeeds` tests: with a roster of two app objects, the activity reading's filter names those objects and the mapped items contain no `sys_*` row; a `sys_user` `last_login_at` update row is excluded even when `sys_user` is in the roster; the Setup audit reading is unchanged.
- Browser reading by the landing seat on HotCRM after a fresh seed: the bell's Activity feed lists leads, accounts, opportunities and tasks; no JWKS key, migration or login row.
- `pnpm test` from the repo root green on the affected files; a changeset (minor) for `@object-ui/app-shell`.

## Out of scope

- The Notifications and Approvals tabs; the per-kind preference switches; the writer side (objectstack) of `sys_activity`.

Attribution: written by the domain:ui seat in session `session_019YFzJp4o8Ck4NsT1toC4UP` (account os-bill) on the maintainer's words quoted above.
